organization.fullName: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study of TQH2722 Injection in the Treatment of Moderate to Severe Atopic Dermatitis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase II Clinical Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of TQH2722 Injection in Subjects With Moderate to Severe Atopic Dermatitis

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This phase II clinical trials is multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled to assess the effectiveness and safety of TQH2722 injection in the treatment of subjects with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis.

armGroups.label: TQH2722 injection 300mg-150mg
armGroups.description: Participants received subcutaneous injection of 300 mg TQH2722 injection + 600 mg placebo on day 1, followed by subcutaneous injection of 150 mg TQH2722 injection + 300 mg placebo on days 15, 29, 43, 57, 71, 85, 99.

armGroups.label: TQH2722 injection 600mg-300mg
armGroups.description: Participants received subcutaneous injection of 600 mg TQH2722 injection + 300 mg placebo on day 1, followed by subcutaneous injection of 300 mg TQH2722 injection + 150 mg placebo on days 15, 29, 43, 57, 71, 85, 99.

armGroups.label: TQH2722 injection 900mg-450mg
armGroups.description: Participants received subcutaneous injection of 900 mg TQH2722 injection on day 1, followed by subcutaneous injection of 450 mg TQH2722 injection on days 15, 29, 43, 57, 71, 85, 99.

armGroups.label: TQH2722 injection matching Placebo
armGroups.description: Subjects received 900mg placebo injection subcutaneously on day 1, followed by 450mg placebo injection on days 15, 29, 43, 57, 71, 85, 99.

interventions.name: TQH2722 injection 300mg-150mg
interventions.description: TQH2722 injection is a fully human monoclonal antibody that interfering with the signal cascade.

interventions.name: TQH2722 injection 600mg-300mg
interventions.description: TQH2722 injection is a fully human monoclonal antibody that thereby interfering with the signal cascade.

interventions.name: TQH2722 injection 900mg-450mg
interventions.description: TQH2722 injection is a fully human monoclonal antibody that thereby interfering with the signal cascade.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Eczema area and severity (EASI)-75 (≥75% improvement from baseline).
primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants with eczema area and severity (EASI)-75 (≥75% improvement from baseline) at week 16.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects with, the investigator's overall assessment (IGA) of 0 or 1 (6-point in total) at week 16.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Eczema area and severity (EASI)-90 (≥90% improvement from baseline).
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants with EASI-90 at week 16.
Percentage change in EASI score from baseline to week 16;
Change (or percentage change) in IGA score from baseline to week 16;
Incidence of TEAE from baseline to week 20 determined by National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI CTC AE) V5.0.

The incidence of anti-drug antibodies (ADAs) of subjects and their titer, the incidence of neutralizing antibodies (Nab). If the subject is tested positive for ADA, a neutralizing antibody is added in the test.
If the subject is tested positive for ADA, a neutralizing antibody is added.
Peak Itch NRS changes from baseline to week 16. The total score is 10, with higher scores indicating more severe pruritus.
DLQI scores change from baseline to week 16, the scores are rated as None, Not Relevant, and 0-3, with higher values representing more serious disease.
